meta.name: Route app store bug reviews to engineering with Claude and Slack

name: AI App Store Review → Engineering Agent

parameters.content:
## AI App Store Review → Engineering Agent

Pulls in app store / play store reviews, uses Claude to detect genuine technical complaints (vs. praise, feature requests, or noise), groups duplicate/related complaints together, correlates them against your known-bug tracker, and either bumps an existing bug's severity or files a brand-new engineering ticket — then tracks it through to resolution and notifies the original reviewers' team when it ships.

### How it works
1. Webhook - New App Store Review Received ingests a review (rating, text, platform, app version, reviewer handle) from your review-monitoring source (App Store Connect / Google Play / a review-aggregator webhook).
2. Claude classifies the review: is this a technical complaint (crash, bug, performance, data loss) vs. praise/feature-request/spam, severity, affected app area, and app version.
3. IF - Is Genuine Technical Complaint? filters out non-technical noise immediately — those are just logged and the flow ends there, no ticket is created.
4. Technical complaints proceed to duplicate/cluster detection: HTTP - Search Similar Recent Complaints pulls recently logged complaints for the same app/version/area, and Claude decides whether this review is a duplicate of an existing cluster or a new distinct issue.
5. HTTP - Search Known Bug Tracker checks your bug tracker (Jira/Linear/GitHub Issues) for an existing open bug matching this cluster.
6. A routing node decides the outcome: bump an existing bug (add review as evidence + reassess severity), open a new engineering ticket for an existing complaint cluster that has no tracked bug yet, or attach this review to an already-open new ticket created earlier in the same run of duplicates.
7. The right action fires: HTTP - Update Existing Bug Severity & Evidence, or HTTP - Create New Engineering Ticket, followed by a Slack alert to the owning engineering team.
8. All paths converge and are logged to the review-to-engineering tracking log, which also powers status lookups so reviewers' complaints can eventually be marked resolved once the linked ticket closes.

### Setup
1. Import this workflow into n8n and activate it.
2. Add credentials: your review-source API/webhook secret, your bug tracker API (Jira/Linear/GitHub Issues), Anthropic Claude, Slack, and your tracking-log API.
3. Edit Set - Config: bug tracker URL, complaint-search URL, team routing map (app area → engineering team/Slack channel), and default channel.
4. Run once with a sample review to confirm classification, clustering, correlation, and routing all work end to end before activating for real review traffic.

## Stage 1: Intake & AI Classification

- **Webhook - New App Store Review Received** — receives the incoming review (rating, text, platform, app version, reviewer handle).
- **Set - Config** — central place for bug tracker, complaint search, and team routing settings.
- **Anthropic - Classification & Correlation Model** — the Claude model shared across all three agents. 🔑
- **AI Agent - Classify Review** — detects genuine technical complaints vs. praise/feature-requests/noise, severity, app area, and app version.
- **JS - Parse Classification Output** — safely parses Claude's classification, defaulting to "treat as technical" if parsing fails.

## Stage 2: Filter, Clustering & Bug Correlation

- **IF - Is Genuine Technical Complaint?** — non-technical reviews (praise, feature requests, spam) are logged and the flow ends; only technical complaints proceed.
- **HTTP - Search Similar Recent Complaints** — pulls recently logged complaints for the same app/version/area. 🔑
- **AI Agent - Detect Duplicate Complaint Cluster** — decides whether this review matches an existing complaint cluster or is a new distinct issue.
- **JS - Parse Cluster Output** — safely parses the clustering decision, defaulting to "treat as new issue" if parsing fails.
- **HTTP - Search Known Bug Tracker** — checks Jira/Linear/GitHub Issues for an existing open bug matching this cluster. 🔑
- **JS - Evaluate Bug Tracker Match** — checks whether a sufficiently confident existing-bug match was found.

## Stage 3: Routing, Ticketing & Tracking

- **JS - Determine Resolution Path & Team** — decides: bump existing bug, create new ticket, or discard as duplicate-noise; picks the owning team/channel by app area.
- **Switch - Route by Resolution Path** — routes to bug-bump or new-ticket creation (or a discard/log-only path for non-technical reviews).
- **HTTP - Update Existing Bug Severity & Evidence** — adds this review as evidence and reassesses severity on the matched bug. 🔑
- **HTTP - Create New Engineering Ticket** — opens a new ticket for a complaint cluster with no existing tracked bug. 🔑
- **Slack - Alert Engineering Team** — notifies the routed team/channel that a ticket needs attention. 🔑
- **Merge - Combine Resolution Branches** — merges the discarded, bug-bumped, and new-ticket paths back into one flow.
- **HTTP - Log Review Outcome to Tracking Log** — records the review, classification, and outcome for tracking through to resolution. 🔑
